decision: NO-GO for this fixed-marker numerical follow-through under the current proposed use; no new values authorized.
question_scope: A bounded empirical pilot was assessed, not only a standalone paper. RNA-only descriptive work need not assign compartments or establish protein to be useful.
independent_reason: The proposed positive result would be expected generic GPNMB-myeloid covariation; it would not alter the already required ordinary/high-EMC, valid high exception, LGFMS comparator and malignant/myeloid/stromal localization measurement. A null or discordant result cannot exclude mixed tissue, unrelated differentiation or marker regulation and cannot justify dropping a compartment. The conditional high/marker-low versus co-high language does not freeze a genuinely new decision-sensitive selection or measurement criterion beyond that existing design.
favorable_validity: Fixed ten genes, gene-specific Spearman, all13/all6, allLOO, highLR retained, all-probe reporting and no ranking/pq/adaptive score/cutoff would constrain outcome selection. Technical computability does not supply the missing use. No empirical covariation result is claimed.
strongest_alternatives: Mixed tissue/unknown purity and correlated transcriptional differentiation without cell-count or identity inference
Unknown donor overlap and handling/year/grade/therapy effects
High-case leverage, n6/probe differences and already expected myeloid association
disproof_before_values: Even concordant positive rho fails usefulness if no concrete new experimental choice changes; null/unstable results would remain ambiguity, not an important refutation or a negative paper.
prior_art: Retained primary Pahl2010 PMID19833906 and Xiong2022 PMID36054938 support nonmalignant/myeloid GPNMB signal in other human contexts, not native EMC cell localization or the uncomputed exact covariation. Prior R8 LST1/AIF1/FCER1G exposure is disclosed; this is not cold target discovery.
all_conditions: All13 native Hof/all6 array observations, all fixed ten markers, all declared probe/missing/zero/tie and LOO conditions remain source-only/unmeasured for this question. No favorable panel shrink or marker absence is inferred. All other native/public sources and overlap statuses remain in previous ledgers; this does not close coverage.
specific_reopening: A before-value source-grounded experimental/measurement decision with actual specimen/control linkage that genuinely differs from the existing ordinary/high plus all-compartment design, with a fixed selection/comparison criterion and how both results change the decision. No new panel, adaptive score or post-outcome sampling rescue.
no_universal_veto: Compartment assignment, paired tissue or protein validation is not required universally for RNA evidence; the failure here is the absence of a consequential new use, not those missing assays alone.
publication: NO; GPNMB narrow candidate held, TMEM266 shelved, goal unmet/search not exhausted.
